company.description:
Clicpiso is a proptech platform that buys and sells flats, offering a quick, simple and transparent proposal.

Founded by Francisco A. Moreno in September 2017, Clipiso was born with the mission of getting its customers to sell their homes immediately and buy the floor of their dreams with all the guarantees. or that, it puts the customer at the center of attention of its business model and relies on state-of-the-art technology to guarantee immediacy and transparency in a process that until now was opaque and complex. Clicpiso eliminates cost overruns and commissions based on its own algorithm based on big data technology and a multidisciplinary work team aimed at allowing its clients to sell and buy real estate at competitive prices.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $109,837,484, or 8.81% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $42,313,571 to $1,792,607,826, a 42.36x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 51 (-13 over 90 days) and market heat at 64 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
